name: Axelrod culture: activation, the docking discrepancy
description: Axtell et al. 1996's docking discrepancy: 5 features of 15 traits, with each event picking a random site (Axelrod) or with each tick one shuffled sweep over every site (the Sugarscape). They found the two alike at 5 × 5 and 10 × 10 but 16.25 vs 9.23 regions at 20 × 20. Measured (release, seeds 1–10, recorded 2026-09-25): 22.0 vs 23.4 at 10 × 10, 23.0 vs 26.5 at 15 × 15, 18.2 vs 11.0 at 20 × 20 — the gap appears at 20 × 20, as they found.
